evidence: Sanitized initialize exchange captured from a real `cursor-agent acp` process. JSON-RPC 2.0 frames over stdio; no credentials, tokens, private paths or user data are included.

sanitization.note: Probe-local identifiers were replaced with fixed placeholders; the exchange itself contains neither credentials nor private paths.

authMethods.name: Cursor Login
authMethods.description: Authenticate using existing Cursor login credentials. Run 'agent login' first if not logged in.

observations: protocolVersion is the JSON number 1, not a string; the handshake comparison must be numeric.
agentCapabilities.loadSession=true allows session/load of a persisted native session.
sessionCapabilities.list is present as an empty object; its presence is capability evidence, not a typed payload contract.
authMethods is descriptive metadata only; LLMWorkGUI never extracts or stores Cursor credentials.
